title: 第3章 初识
slug: 官榜全本免费-官榜最新章节列表
content_zh:
尽管在体制内摸爬滚打了一年,苏沐仍然只是个菜鸟。猛然间瞧见这些权谋之术,像是饥渴的游人似的,拼命汲取着。每天吸收每天消化,苏沐感觉自己以前实在是太弱太傻,原来当官还能这样当。
而这几天苏沐也对官榜有所了解,原来这个神秘的榜单,每天只能够施展五次,超过五个人便不会再显露出来。而且这五次不能累计,当天用完和用不完,第二天都会是重新开始列出。
官榜之所以为官榜,很为简单,针对的便是那些拥有着官身的人。只要你是官,只要和苏沐有着身体接触,哪怕再小的官位,官榜都能够显示出来你的资料。
这样便够惊人,但更让苏沐震惊的是官榜竟然还能晋级!
只要有着足够多的能量注入,官榜便能为苏沐提供更多的资料,而这个所谓的能量之源便是玉石!
......
整整八天,当所有东西全部被消化吸收后,苏沐整个人便好像脱胎换骨般,散发出一股截然不同的气质。
苏沐的背景很简单,就是普普通通的一个农民家庭出身,父母为了能够供养他上大学,起早贪黑的帮人做事。姐姐为了他甚至连初中都没读完便辍学在家,早早嫁人后帮着家里干活,时不时的接济苏沐。
亲眼目睹家里的艰难日子,苏沐深感痛心的同时,越发发奋图强的学习。大学四年更是兼职无数,只要能帮到家里减轻些负担,他是什么活都做。
就是在这样的情形下,苏沐心底一直有着很为强烈的抱负:我必须要当官,当大官,掌重权,让全国孩子有饭吃,有书读,让所有贫困家庭不再为生活拖累,让每家每户都过上幸福太平的日子。
“还真是上天眷恋,我要是这样都不能抓住机会向上进步,都丢不起这人。官榜,你放心,我不会让你失望的!”
苏沐嘴角露出微笑,在清晨阳光的照耀下,很快便收拾好东西。其实他也没有什么,就连身上穿着的这身衣服还是叶惜帮忙买的。至于以前那件,则因为救人废掉。
“你真的要走?”叶惜有些舍不得问道。
“当然!”苏沐笑道:“我要是再不走的话,估计回到黑山镇就会被彻底开除公职。叶惜,记着你说过两天要帮我忙的。”
“当然,我说话算话!”叶惜点点头,“我这几天已经准备的差不多,等过几天我没那么多课了便下去找你。不过到时候你要请我吃饭,我要吃当地的特色菜!”
“行,没问题!”苏沐拍着胸膛道。
“我送你!”
“好!”
自始至终叶惜都没有给苏沐说过叶安邦的身份,苏沐也没有问。他虽然很想找到这么一座靠山,但却不屑于通过这种办法。和叶惜之交,苏沐不希望有着太多功利性的东西在内,就这种感觉便很好。
“苏沐,等着我,我肯定去找你!”

就在汽车开出车站后,叶惜突然间摇动着手臂大声喊道。阵阵清风刮过,吹动着她的白色长裙,阳光中时间仿佛在这一刻定格。苏沐眼中只有一朵盛开的百合花,瞧着叶惜的摇曳生姿,脸上露出舒心的微笑。
“叶惜,现在的我一穷二白,就算有心想要追你,却没有那个资格。不过你放心,只要给我足够的时间,只要你同意,我便会堂堂正正的上门求婚。”
长途汽车经过几个小时才到邢唐县,这时已经是中午。苏沐就算着急赶回去,也不能空着肚子,亏待了自己。下车后便随便在车站旁边的小摊上,要了碗面条开始吃起来。
和黑山镇相比,邢唐县无疑就是天堂,这里的街道很干净,两边都栽种着整齐的杨树。浓郁的树荫遮挡着夏天的炙热,给这里带来些许的凉意。
吃完面条后,苏沐便坐上回黑山镇的汽车。要知道前往黑山镇,只有这么一趟车,要是错过的话再想要回去就只能等到明天。
“等下!”
就在汽车快要开动的时候,从旁边闪出一道身影,喘着气着急忙慌的走上来,扫了眼一屁股坐在苏沐旁边。
“大哥,我坐这儿没事吧?”男子笑着问道。

content_en:
Despite working hard within the system for a year, Su Mu was still just a rookie. Suddenly I saw these tactics and tricks, like hungry tourists, trying to absorb them. Absorbing and digesting every day, Su Mu felt that she was too weak and stupid before, but it turned out that she could still be like this as an official.
In the past few days, Su Mu also learned about the official list. It turns out that this mysterious list can only be used five times a day, and more than five people will no longer be revealed. Moreover, these five times cannot be accumulated. If the items are used up or not used up on the same day, the list will start again the next day.
The reason why the official list is an official list is very simple. It is aimed at those who have official status. As long as you are an official, as long as you have physical contact with Su Mu, no matter how small your official position is, your information will be displayed on the official list.
This was astonishing enough, but what shocked Su Mu even more was that he was still promoted on the official list!
As long as enough energy is injected into it, the official list can provide Su Mu with more information, and this so-called source of energy is jade!
...
For eight days, when everything was digested and absorbed, Su Mu's whole person seemed to be completely transformed, exuding a completely different temperament.
Su Mu's background is very simple. He comes from an ordinary peasant family. In order to support him in college, his parents worked early and late to help others. Because of him, his sister dropped out of school before even finishing junior high school. After marrying early, she helped the family with work and supported Su Mu from time to time.
Witnessing the difficult days at home, Su Mu felt deeply sad and at the same time, she studied harder and harder. During the four years of college, he worked numerous part-time jobs. As long as it could help relieve some of the burden on his family, he would do anything.
It was under such circumstances that Su Mu always had a very strong ambition in his heart: I must be an official, a high-ranking official, and hold great power, so that children across the country can have food to eat and study, so that all poor families will no longer be burdened by life, and let every family live a happy and peaceful life.
"God is really loving me. If I can't seize the opportunity to make progress like this, I can't afford to lose this person. Guanbang, don't worry, I won't let you down!"
Su Mu smiled, and quickly packed her things under the early morning sun. In fact, he didn't have much, even the clothes he was wearing were bought with Ye Xi's help. As for the previous one, it was scrapped because of saving people.
"Are you really going to leave?" Ye Xi asked reluctantly.
"Of course!" Su Mu said with a smile: "If I don't leave, I will probably be completely fired when I return to Heishan Town. Ye Xi, remember you said you would help me in two days."
"Of course, I keep what I say!" Ye Xi nodded, "I have almost prepared it these days. I will come down to you in a few days when I don't have so many classes. But then you have to treat me to dinner, and I want to eat local specialties!"
"Okay, no problem!" Su Mu said, patting her chest.
"I'll give it to you!"
"Okay!"
From the beginning to the end, Ye Xi never told Su Mu Ye Anbang's identity, and Su Mu didn't ask. Although he really wanted to find such a backer, he disdained this method. Su Mu didn't want to have too many utilitarian things in his acquaintance with Ye Xi, so this feeling was good.
"Su Mu, wait for me, I will definitely go find you!"
Just after the car drove out of the station, Ye Xi suddenly shook her arms and shouted loudly. The breeze blew by, blowing her white dress, and time seemed to freeze at this moment in the sunshine. There was only one blooming lily in Su Mu's eyes. Looking at Ye Xi's swaying posture, a comfortable smile appeared on her face.
"Ye Xi, I'm broke now. Even if I want to pursue you, I don't have the qualifications. But don't worry, as long as you give me enough time and you agree, I will come to propose to you in an upright manner."
The long-distance bus took several hours to reach Xingtang County, and it was already noon. Even if Su Mu rushes back in a hurryDon't go there on an empty stomach or do yourself a disservice. After getting off the bus, I casually stopped at a stall next to the station, ordered a bowl of noodles and started eating.
Compared with Heishan Town, Xingtang County is undoubtedly paradise. The streets here are very clean and neat poplar trees are planted on both sides. The rich shade of trees blocks the scorching heat of summer and brings a little coolness here.
After eating the noodles, Su Mu got on the bus back to Heishan Town. You must know that there is only one bus to Heishan Town. If you miss it, you will have to wait until tomorrow if you want to go back.
"Wait a minute!"
Just when the car was about to start, a figure flashed out from the side, panting and hurriedly walked up, glanced at it, and sat down next to Su Mu.
"Brother, is it okay if I sit here?" the man asked with a smile.
